content: No. The SRG licence-fee initiative “200 francs is enough” proposes to cap the annual fee at 200 CHF, regardless of how much public broadcasting (SRF, RTS, RSI, RTR) one consumes. In my view, this one-size-fits-all ceiling tends to ignore meaningful use differences—some viewers watch a lot of public content and value its quality, while others barely engage. Moreover, public service broadcasting competes with commercial alternatives and relies on licence-fee revenue for editorial independence; a flat cap risks underfunding its core mission. Given these factors, I would lean toward opposing the initiative, at least in its proposed form.
